Core.desc: General commands for configuration, info, and diagnostics.

Moderation.desc: Moderation tools, case edits, channel controls, and cleanup.

User.desc: User/profile utilities: whois, avatars, banners, IDs, roles.

Utility.desc: Server utilities: roles, server info, and channel metadata.

Access.desc: Global allowlist control for who can use the bot.

Owner.desc: Owner-only tools for cloning/copying messages across channels/servers.

help.brief: Show help for commands or categories.
help.desc: Displays an overview of categories, or detailed info for a given category/command.

subcommands.name: overview
subcommands.brief: List all categories and their commands.

subcommands.name: category
subcommands.brief: Show commands in a category with short descriptions.

subcommands.name: command
subcommands.brief: Show usage, aliases, and details for a command.

helpui.desc: Opens a dropdown UI to browse categories → commands → example usages.

helprefresh.desc: Reloads the local help_descriptions.json without restarting the bot (requires Manage Server).

ping.desc: Shows the current WebSocket latency in milliseconds.

uptime.brief: Show how long the bot has been online.
uptime.desc: Displays the time elapsed since the last restart.

invite.desc: Sends an invite link button using Administrator permissions.

about.desc: Shows overview, version, developer, library versions, and quick stats.

stats.desc: Shows guilds, members, channels, commands loaded, latency, uptime, and CPU/RAM (when available).

prefix.brief: View or change the server prefix.
prefix.desc: Shows the current prefix, or updates it (requires Manage Server to change).

feedback.desc: DMs or logs a feedback message for the developers.

bug.brief: Report a bug to the developers.
bug.desc: Sends a quick bug report describing what went wrong.
usage: {p}bug Command X crashes when I do Y

broadcast.brief: Broadcast an announcement to all servers.
broadcast.desc: Owner-only: sends a styled embed announcement to every guild where the bot can speak, after a confirmation step.
usage: {p}broadcast We just shipped a new feature!

modlog.desc: Sets or clears the channel where moderation actions are logged.

warn.brief: Warn a user and log the case.
warn.desc: Issues a warning to a user, optionally DMing them, and logs the case in the mod-log with a case number.

warns.desc: Shows all recorded warns for a user, including case numbers and reasons.

clearwarns.desc: Clears all warns for a user, or a specific case if provided.

kick.brief: Kick a member from the server.
kick.desc: Removes a member from the guild and logs a moderation case.

ban.brief: Ban a user from the server.
ban.desc: Bans a user by mention or ID, optionally deleting recent messages, and logs the action.

unban.desc: Lifts a ban using a user ID or name#discrim and logs the unban.

mute.desc: Mutes a member by assigning a mute role or using your configured system, then logs the case.

unmute.brief: Remove a mute from a user.
unmute.desc: Reverses a previous mute and logs the unmute case.

timeout.desc: Uses native Discord timeouts for a specified duration (e.g., 10m, 2h, 1d) and logs the action.

reason.brief: Edit the reason of a logged case.
reason.desc: Updates the reason field on an existing moderation case.

duration.brief: Edit the duration of a logged case.
duration.desc: Changes the stored duration on a case (for mutes/timeouts) in the mod-log index.

purge.desc: Deletes up to a given number of messages with optional filters for bots, humans, images, links, etc.

subcommands.name: images
subcommands.brief: Delete messages that contain image attachments.

subcommands.name: humans
subcommands.brief: Delete messages sent by non-bot users.

subcommands.name: text
subcommands.brief: Delete messages with plain text (no attachments).

clean.desc: Erases Helix’s messages and command invocations in the channel. Automatically detects the current prefix.

lock.desc: Temporarily prevents sending messages in a text channel until unlocked.

unlock.desc: Restores send-message permissions for @everyone in the channel.

slowmode.desc: Sets a cooldown (in seconds) between messages. Use 'off' to disable.

modstats.desc: Displays how many actions (warns, kicks, bans, etc.) each moderator has logged in this server, with optional filter by moderator.

gif.brief: Send a random GIF matching your query.
gif.desc: Searches a GIF provider and returns a relevant random GIF inside an embed.

meme.desc: Fetches a random meme from a meme API/subreddit and sends it as an embed.

trivia.desc: Starts a multiple-choice trivia question, optionally filtered by category and difficulty. Users answer with reaction buttons A/B/C/D.

triviacats.desc: Shows the supported trivia categories you can pass into the {p}trivia command (e.g. anime, games, movies).

poll.desc: Creates a poll with clickable buttons for each option. Users can vote with one click.
usage: {p}poll Which map? op: Map A, Map B, Map C
{p}poll Best anime op: AOT, JJK, OP

endpoll.desc: Ends an active poll created by {p}poll using its message ID and posts the final results.

8ball.desc: Answers a yes/no style question with a mix of witty, rude, and polite responses.
usage: {p}8ball Should I pull for this banner?

roll.desc: Rolls dice in NdM format (e.g. 2d6, 1d20). If no arguments are provided, defaults to a single d6.

rps.desc: Choose rock/paper/scissors (or r/p/s). The bot replies with its choice and the result.

quote.brief: Generate a quote image from a message.
quote.desc: Takes a message by reply or ID/link and renders it as a quote card image using the author’s avatar as the background. Skips bot messages and very long content.
usage: {p}quote (used as a reply to a message)

userinfo.desc: Displays detailed info about a user: ID, creation time, join time, badges, roles in this server, inferred role (Admin/Mod/Staff/etc.), and key permissions. Works with mentions, IDs, profile URLs, or by default yourself.

avatar.desc: Shows a user’s avatar in maximum resolution with quick links to PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF variants where available.

banner.desc: Fetches and displays the user’s banner (if they have one) at high resolution with a direct image preview.

nick.desc: Changes the nickname of a member (if allowed by hierarchy). Fails gracefully on unmanageable or higher-role targets.

roles.brief: List a user’s roles in this server.
roles.desc: Shows all roles a member has in the current guild, sorted by hierarchy.

id.brief: Show IDs of users, channels, roles, and guilds.
id.desc: Quick helper to print useful IDs. When used without arguments, shows your ID and the current guild/channel IDs.

addrole.desc: Creates a new role with optional flags for color, hoist, and mentionability.

delrole.brief: Delete a role by mention, ID, or name.
delrole.desc: Deletes a role if the bot’s top role is higher. Useful for cleaning up unused roles.

role.brief: Toggle a role on a member.
role.desc: Adds or removes a role from a member, checking hierarchy and permissions. Accepts mention, ID, or name for the role.

rolesearch.desc: Finds roles whose names contain the given text (case-insensitive), showing mentions and IDs, sorted by position.

roleinfo.brief: Show detailed information about a role.
roleinfo.desc: Shows ID, position, color, member count, creation date, whether it’s hoisted/managed/mentionable, plus an inferred role significance and key permissions (excluding common user permissions).

rolemembers.brief: List members that have a given role.
rolemembers.desc: Lists all members with the specified role, sorted by top-role position and join date.

serverinfo.brief: Show info about the current server.
serverinfo.desc: Displays server ID, owner, member stats, channel counts, roles count, and creation time with the server icon thumbnail.

icon.desc: Sends the server icon in maximum resolution as an embed image.

channelinfo.desc: Shows details about a channel (text/voice/stage/forum/thread), including ID, type, category, position, creation time, and extra fields like topic, NSFW, slowmode, bitrate, etc.

allowrole.brief: Toggle a role’s access to the bot.
allowrole.desc: Administrator-only: adds or removes a role from the global allowlist for this server. Admins and the bot owner are always allowed regardless.

clone.brief: Clone the last N messages between channels (owner-only).
clone.desc: Owner-only cross-server cloning tool. Clones the last N messages from a source channel (or message link) to a target channel, skipping system/webhook messages, converting mentions to plaintext, and preserving attachments as much as possible. Includes anti-spam delays and a DM’d summary.

countclone.brief: Test how many recent messages are cloneable.
countclone.desc: Counts how many of the last N messages in a channel the bot would be able to clone (checking length, attachments, and basic constraints). Useful before running {p}clone.

clonemsg.brief: Clone a single message into another channel.
clonemsg.desc: Owner-only: clones one specific message by ID into a target channel, including text and attachments, obeying the same sanitisation rules as the bulk clone.
